ideas.title: Uncovering the $19 Billion Minnesota Fraud Allegation
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged $19 billion in fraud in Minnesota, including connections to child care funding and the Hudson Tunnel Project.
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail to uncover the extent of the fraud and involved entities.
questions: What is the source of the $19 billion allegation?
How is the fraud connected to child care funding and the Hudson Tunnel Project?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose large-scale fraud in Minnesota, with significant implications for state authorities and federal agencies.

ideas.title: The Impact of Right-Wing Influencers on Minnesota Child Care Centers
ideas.description: Investigate the impact of right-wing influencers targeting Somali child care centers in Minnesota, and potential connections to the alleged fraud.
ideas.angle: Analyze the role of influencers in spreading misinformation and the effects on child care centers.
questions: What is the extent of the influencer targeting?
Are there connections to the alleged $19 billion in fraud?
searches: Right-wing influencers targeting Somali child care centers
ideas.insight: This story could reveal a complex web of misinformation and its effects on vulnerable populations in Minnesota.
